observations: Puderbaugh MA. “A Report of Transverse Process Fractures Secondary to the Centrifuge in a Healthy Aviator.” Aerospace Medicine and Human Performance. 2016;87(7):655–658.

entities.name: Centrifuge-related fractures
observations: Case report describes a 32-year-old female flight surgeon with left L2 and bilateral L3 transverse-process fractures after centrifuge training; authors cited mild vitamin D deficiency but no other contributory cause, supporting an association without definitive causal proof.
